# Capacitor 8 template files

`LaunchScreen.storyboard`, `SceneDelegate.swift` and `Splash.imageset.Contents.json` (iOS, from
`@capacitor/cli` 8.5.2's `ios-spm-template`) and `styles.xml` (Android `res/values/`, from its
`android-template`), unmodified: the files `denext mobile add app-config` edits to carry an Expo
app's launch and background colours. Capacitor is MIT-licensed
(https://github.com/ionic-team/capacitor).
